column2: type 1 (ms 0) running mask, returns at once
mode 1 / 2 (ms > 1, settings byte 99 = 1) hide the text window (0x89E)
mode none or -1: hides only under settings byte 99 = 0
column7: what byte 99 is on the settings screen: FUN_0012c810 callers

column2: m <= 0 stops the motion (the layer stays as it is)
column5: a loop stopped (4 of the 92; the rest stop motions that don't loop: run on to their end), back at its place
column7: open: stop where it is (an engine stop that keeps the offset)

column2: mode 1 / 2 hide the text window (as _FADS, no ms condition)
p (argument 3): start time of the motion
keys of motion m: [end(m-1), end(m)), length = last key's time
0x04 easing (Penner set, 0/1 straight), from the last key before
column5: followed: each key's curve, spcurve tables of the exe's functions
column7: open: a field passed through (-32766) eased per key, not across

before the first key's time the layer stays
i32 0x14 turn 1/100 deg (-100001 unchanged, -100000 no key)

loop start FUN_001999a0 (0 none, 1 the start, else ms; past the length: the start); 2,027 motions
column5: spmotion loop 1, or 4 from the key nearest the time (16 of 222 between keys)

column2: _STCH/_SCH2 stop the layer's motion (at once; with argument 18 at the _FADS, the copy's goes on)

column2: a looping layer moved to another IR layer (priority order) or changed at a _FADS

layer > 39 ignored; empty picture clears the layer
x*640/1280, y*480/720; one left out keeps the layer's or the copied one's

18 copy every setting from a layer
18 copy from a layer with no picture copies its blank settings
without 18: effect, parent, effect colour reset
19 angle (normalised to +-18000) to 0xbe4, not the _STRT turn 0x284

without 18 keeps the old picture's centre

turn 1/100 deg to `to` from `from` over ms*60/1000 frames; cx, cy
fade out in 4 frames; nothing if the window isn't up
fade out over ms (skip or ms <= 0: at once)
